about: The pronunciation standard of the remake's voices: remake/tools/voice-lines.mjs and remake/tools/yatzy-junior-voices.mjs apply it to every line they send.

One entry per hard word: "word" (its name in the pronunciation book), "stem" (a regular expression for the start of every inflection, which remake/tests/pronunciation.test.mjs checks over all the sets and Litla Yatzy), "forms" (the surface forms, matched case-sensitively as whole words), optional "except" (words the stem matches that are not this word), "recipes" and "chosen".

A recipe: "say" (what is sent in place of the form: one string for every form, or form -> string; IPA goes in double quotes and slashes, "/.../", the way Eleven v4 reads it), "context" (sent as previous_text, never spoken: a string, or speaker -> string with "*" for the rest), "seed", and "note" (for the owner, shown in the book). "hratt" sends the word as written.

"chosen" is the recipe the owner picked by ear in the pronunciation book (node remake/tools/voice-lines.mjs --pick picks.json), or null: then the word is sent as written. "audition" (speaker -> sentence) gives the book a sentence for a speaker who has no line with the word.
The text the child sees (lines-source.json, the captions, lines.json) is never changed: only the request is.
